definitions.explanation: A period of strong economic growth and activity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{好況|こうきょう}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{好況|こうきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
{好況|こうきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沸|わ}く→沸く：01122_waku⟧。

notes:
{好況|こうきょう} refers to economic prosperity or a boom period—when business is thriving.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {好況|こうきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沸|わ}く→沸く：01122_waku⟧: to be in the midst of a boom
- ⟦{空前|くうぜん}→空前：22320_kuuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{好況|こうきょう}: unprecedented prosperity
- {好況|こうきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: prosperity continues
- {好況|こうきょう}⟦{時|じ}→〜時：03094_toki⟧: during good economic times

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {好況|こうきょう}: prosperity, boom
- ⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧: recession, depression
- ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧: economic conditions (general term)

WRITING:
{好|こう} (good) + {況|きょう} (condition) = good economic condition.
